'''Whuffa leather''' was a material made from [[whuffa worm]] skin. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], whuffa leather was used as [[Currency/Legends|currency]] for common trade amongst the [[Witches of Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The use of a natural product as a commodity money amongst the Witches of Dathomir mirrors real-world system of [[Wikipedia:Commodity money|commodity money]] developed in early cultures all over the world.
